Sign To Speak: offline hand-landmark tracking components

MediaPipe Tasks Vision 1.1.1 and Tasks Core: Copyright The MediaPipe Authors.
Licensed under Apache License 2.0; the complete upstream SDK NOTICE is included
unchanged as mediapipe-tasks-1.1.1-NOTICE. Its generic telemetry statement describes
the publisher's SDK. This application uses a source-built Tasks Core from commit
50505c8312c7eacb1bd411cecdc4cc9fd08d53cb with ENABLE_TASKS_USAGE_LOGGING=0.
TasksStatsLoggerFactory calls the upstream TasksStatsDummyLogger. DataTransport
dependencies, permissions and components are not admitted. No SDK classes or
permission declarations were patched or hidden to obtain this result.
The official published ARM64 native library is retained unchanged. Other process
ABIs do not initialize this detector; other application features remain available.

Holistic Landmarker float16 version 1 model bundle: Google / MediaPipe Authors.
Unmodified model bytes distributed under Apache License 2.0, as identified by
the model cards linked from Google's Holistic Landmarker documentation.
https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/holistic_landmarker
The separate MODEL-RECEIPT.json identifies the immutable download, hash, size
and model-card sources. This is landmark tracking, not sign recognition,
translation, medical interpretation or identity recognition.

Flogger 0.6 and flogger-system-backend 0.6: Google LLC; Apache License 2.0.
Protobuf Java Lite 4.26.1: Google Inc.; BSD-3-Clause. Their exact upstream
license texts are included. Other third-party notices remain in the complete
MediaPipe SDK NOTICE and the application's existing framework notice assets.

Application integration and this notice: Copyright 2026 Sign To Speak contributors.
